versions.content: Authentication of secure coding data If the Dcm receives the routine control service referred by DcmSecureCodingValidationRoutine it shall verify if the signature matches the authentication provided by the secure coding certifi- cate by using the crypto job configured by DcmSecureCodingAuthenticationJo- bRef with a signature obtained by the one and only routine control request parameter and the secure coding data buffer as data to verify.
